name: Habitat
role: Protected life support, medical and essential communications.

name: Science
role: Laboratories and assay equipment. Defer noncritical experiments during a shortage.

name: Cultivation
role: Food and cultivation lighting. Essential crew systems remain on the vital bus.

name: Water pilot
role: Water processing and an optional waste-heat connection.

name: Cargo pad
role: Proposed cargo delivery point with dispatchable fabrication and propellant processing.

name: Power park
role: Firm generating capacity. PV is supplementary.
